notes.title: Late August 9th update information, in fact, we've updated 3 versions in 2 weeks
notes.content:
V1.5
Fixed some of the bug that led to the card screen in the transmission and tomb interaction
Text description for partial effects
Effect of repairing the Berserker and blood cap Talisman
Fixed the problem that blood strips do not disappear in certain cases
V1.6
An emergency fix was made for some of the texture content errors
V1.7
Increase the transfer function restrictions, reduce the possibility of bug
Modified aphrodisiac scroll to increase the role of HP way, and now more practical
Fixed the problem of HP degradation in some equipment during loading and unloading
Fixed 1 monsters in combat that were killed 2 times, resulting in repeated rewards
